Engineering calculator: UPS power with margin, number and capacity of batteries for the required autonomy, diesel generator and stabiliser ratings. Suitable models from the AEC catalogue, engineer's check of the calculation free of charge.
1–10 kVA UPS with single-phase input and output for server racks, communication cabinets, checkouts and security systems. Built-in batteries, connection of external battery modules, SNMP monitoring.
Modular UPS with 25–50 kVA hot-swap power modules: Salicru SLC ADAPT2, Kehua MR33, Tescom MTW. N+1 redundancy, power expansion without replacing the system, cabinets up to 600 kVA.
Battery cabinets and modules for extending UPS autonomy: configured for the specific model and the required runtime, with DC breakers and connectors.

Stationary storage batteries from 7 to 3250 Ah: 12 V AGM for UPS, 2 V OPzV and OPzS cells with a 15–20 year service life for substations, DC auxiliary power and telecom. Hoppecke, BAE, Ritar, EnerGrid, Exide. Popular 12 V items in stock in Almaty.
2 V cells with tubular plates: gel OPzV (Hoppecke grid power VR M, BAE Secura) and OPzS with liquid electrolyte. Capacity from 100 to 3250 Ah, service life 18–20 years.
Catalogue of UPS, diesel generators, storage batteries and voltage stabilisers. Filters by power, number of phases, version and brand. Supply from the Almaty warehouse and to order across Kazakhstan.

Single-phase on-line double-conversion UPS of 4–10 kVA in a universal 2U–3U Rack/Tower enclosure. Output power factor 0.9, built-in batteries and the option of connecting external battery modules for longer autonomy, parallel operation of up to three units from 6 kVA.

Third generation of single-phase Salicru Rack/Tower UPS of 4–10 kVA: power factor 1.0 (kVA equals kW), efficiency up to 95 % in on-line mode, built-in Ethernet port and SNMP slot, parallel operation of up to four units. Built-in batteries, external battery modules for long autonomy.

Three-phase monolithic Salicru UPS of 10–40 kVA with double conversion, power factor 1.0 and efficiency up to 96 %. Compact floor-standing enclosure, external battery cabinets for the required autonomy, parallel operation of up to four units, RS-485, Modbus and SNMP interfaces.

Salicru modular system with 25 and 50 kVA power modules, hot swap and power expansion up to 500 kVA in a cabinet, up to 1500 kVA in parallel. Three-level PWM topology, efficiency up to 96 % in on-line mode, N+1 redundancy with one extra module. Monitoring via NIMBUS, SNMP and Modbus.
Single-phase tower Kehua UPS of 1–10 kVA with double conversion, built-in batteries and power factor 0.9. SNMP card slot, EPO port, parallel operation of up to three units on the larger models.

Three-phase Kehua UPS of 10–120 kVA with double conversion, power factor 1.0 and efficiency up to 96 %. External batteries, parallel operation of up to four units, Modbus and SNMP for integration into the building monitoring system.
Kehua modular UPS with 25/50 kVA power modules and cabinets of 150–600 kVA. Hot-swap modules, N+1 redundancy, efficiency up to 96.5 %, extended 36-month warranty, up to four cabinets combined.

Three-phase Tescom UPS of 10–40 kVA with double conversion and power factor 1.0 for server rooms, clinics and office buildings. External battery cabinets, parallel operation of up to four units, RS-485 and SNMP.

Transformer-based three-phase Tescom UPS of 40–200 kVA with galvanic isolation of the output and increased overload capacity. Designed for pulsed and inductive loads: X-ray machines, machine tools, pumps, compressors. IP21 protection, parallel operation of up to six units.
Tescom modular UPS with 10–50 kVA power modules and cabinets of 30–600 kVA. Hot swap, N+1 redundancy, efficiency up to 96 %, step-by-step power expansion as the load grows.

Three-phase electromechanical Tescom stabilisers with servo drive and independent regulation of each phase. Regulation accuracy ±1 %, high overload capacity, power range from 10 to 3200 kVA for factories, pumping stations and whole buildings.

Three-phase electronic Salicru stabilisers with thyristor switching of autotransformer taps: no moving parts or wear, fast response to voltage surges, quiet operation. For healthcare, data centres and office buildings.
Single-phase electromechanical EverExceed stabilisers of 1–10 kVA in wall-mounted and floor-standing versions for offices, retail outlets, boiler rooms and private sites. Stock items in Almaty.

Three-phase four-pole Tescom static transfer switches for 100–1250 A for distribution boards of data centres and industrial sites. Transfer between sources in less than 4 ms, manual bypass, SNMP and RS-485.
Single-phase rack-mount Tescom static transfer switches for 16–63 A for powering single-supply equipment from two UPS. Transfer in less than 4 ms, SNMP monitoring.
Sealed gel cell with tubular positive plates (OPzV, VRLA): no water topping up, can be installed in the same room as the equipment, resistant to deep discharge.
Cell with liquid electrolyte and tubular positive plates (OPzS): maximum life in cyclic mode, requires electrolyte level monitoring and a ventilated room.
Sealed maintenance-free AGM battery (electrolyte in a glass mat) for float mode in a UPS: low internal resistance, high discharge currents, installation in any position.
